# Metaversesherpa AI Trading Platform

> Metaversesherpa is an automated algorithmic trading platform designed for both traditional equities and cryptocurrencies, featuring AI-driven portfolio diagnostic tools.

## Core Features
1. **Automated Trade Execution**: Hands-free bots executing proprietary quantitative strategies via API.
2. **AI Portfolio Auditing**: Gemini AI-powered diagnostic engine that evaluates static portfolios, provides health scores, and recommends actionable reallocation plans.

## Proprietary Strategies

### Valkyrie Elite Scalper
- **Asset Class**: Cryptocurrency
- **Philosophy**: Targets high-integrity trend continuation pullbacks on high-volume assets using Bollinger Bands, volatility squeeze, and ADX.
- **Backtest (3 Years)**: 58.4% Win Rate, 4.12 Sharpe Ratio, -19.5% Maximum Drawdown.
- **Frequency**: High-frequency scalping.

### Sherpa Velocity Pullback
- **Asset Class**: US Equities
- **Philosophy**: Captures short-term oversold pullback cycles on megacap US equities during robust uptrends.
- **Backtest (5 Years)**: 68.4% Win Rate, 2.14 Sharpe Ratio, -22.7% Maximum Drawdown.
- **Frequency**: Daily swing trading.

## Broker & Exchange Integrations
- **Stocks/Equities**: Alpaca
- **Cryptocurrency**: Binance, Coinbase, Blofin, Bitget

## Pricing
- **Standard Tier**: Free. Includes portfolio diagnostics and basic tracking (read-only).
- **Premium Tier**: $20.00 USD (paid via TRON USDT). Unlocks full automated trade execution, live algorithmic signals, and API broker integration.
